meta.title: Live captions
meta.description: Turns the audio your computer plays plus the microphone into live multilingual subtitles. Recognition runs on this machine: the ~230 MB SenseVoice model downloads in the background once the plugin is active (from hf-mirror in mainland China), and audio is never uploaded. Each recognised line is translated into the language you pick and shown in a system always-on-top overlay: the source line above, the translation below, draggable and resizable, still visible when DeepSeek Harness is minimised, and opened automatically when capture starts. Open the panel from the "Live captions" pill at the bottom right, pick the audio source, the spoken language and the subtitle language, then press "Start"; at the end, "Minutes" puts the transcript and the minutes prompt into a new session. Translation can use the cloud model, a built-in offline multilingual model (an extra 90–640 MB download), or your own Ollama / LM Studio server. Windows x64 only, because capture uses WASAPI loopback; the bundle inserts the host's speech-to-text rows itself, so do not enable it together with the bundled Voice input plugin.

minutesHint: Opens a new session and sends the minutes request automatically
minutesAutoSendFailed: Auto-send failed; the prompt is filled in the composer — press Enter to send.
minutesManualSend: The minutes prompt is ready in a new session — press Enter to send.
